calls.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic visual target for a reusable Blender game prop, NOT a screenshot of a game. Create a beautifully realistic food product photograph of TWO Japanese CHIKUWA fish cakes, matching shape and size, arranged in two horizontal rows with ample separation on a seamless matte light warm-gray studio surface. Upper row: appetizing ordinary chikuwa. Lower row: a fictional purple toxic color variant of the exact same food shape. Both are straight, near-horizontal, parallel, viewed from the same slightly elevated three-quarter angle with the right open end clearly visible. The entire two fish cakes are in focus, large in frame, no cropping. Each is about 14cm long and 3cm in diameter, unmistakably real Japanese grilled tubular surimi fish cake. A real continuous hollow passage with a modest irregular rounded hole, thick fleshy off-white rim on the normal version. Soft ivory fish paste visible at both ends, lightly uneven but mostly smooth, fine moist food texture, NO mesh/grid/checker grain. The middle 65–70% of each has a THIN caramel-brown toasted skin, closely hugging the body, irregular shallow puffed blisters, delicate small crinkles, mottled golden tan to chestnut patches with a few deeper toasted spots. Skin should look appetizing and delicate, NOT thick scales. The silhouette is mostly smooth with very subtle local blister irregularities, never segmented. No circumferential rings, no repeated transverse ridges, no coil, no worm or insect anatomy, no armored plates, no large bumps, no waffle pattern, no burnt black crust. Upper normal fish cake must look like a fresh grocery-store chikuwa, convincingly photographed. Lower toxic version is geometrically identical: plum-violet fish paste, dark aubergine / burgundy toasted patches, a little residual golden brown, same thin natural crinkled skin and modest moist satin gloss. Input image is ONLY a color reference for the lower toxic version; DO NOT copy its dish, soup, lighting, ridged silhouette, or composition. Neutral soft broad studio lighting with gentle natural shadows; broad restrained highlights, no metallic reflections or plastic shine; accurate food color and microtexture. Both items rest naturally on the surface. Clean product-reference composition, landscape 3:2. No text, labels, arrows, utensils, plate, garnish, people, eyes, limbs, horror elements, watermark or logo.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production UV base-color texture for a 3D Japanese chikuwa fish-cake model. Input image: visual target ONLY, use the UPPER NORMAL CHIKUWA as the food material reference. Produce a SINGLE completely FLAT RECTANGULAR unwrapped surface texture, edge-to-edge pixels, NOT an object photo, NOT a cylinder, NOT a scene. Portrait aspect 2:3. The vertical image direction represents the entire length of the fish cake; the horizontal direction wraps once around its circumference. The top 13% and bottom 13% must be creamy ivory steamed fish paste with a very fine soft irregular organic food surface. The middle approximately 70% has appetizing thin grilled chikuwa skin: amber golden tan and chestnut toasted mottling, some little darker roasted spots, tiny shallow puffed blisters and delicate natural crinkling. Preserve the food realism of the reference's upper chikuwa but flatten out ALL its form, perspective, holes, edge outlines, shadows and highlights. The central browned area meets the pale end zones along irregular organic soft boundaries at top and bottom, not straight bands. Left and right texture edges should meet seamlessly with matching colors and structure at the same height, no border. Subtle varied small crinkles, no large scales or plates, no repetitive pattern, no transverse ridges, no rings, no grid, no checker, no worm/insect features. Low-frequency natural variation rather than a uniform brown stripe. Physically plausible basecolor: diffuse evenly lit, no baked glossy reflection, no cast shadow, no ambient occlusion, no vignetting. NO hole, silhouette, background, tabletop, perspective, depth, text, label, watermark, multiple panels, border, or purple. Output only the flat texture filling the whole frame.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this UV texture into the purple toxic chikuwa color variant. Change ONLY the colors; preserve the exact same 1024x1536 portrait texture layout, patch boundaries, pore and wrinkle locations, image alignment, and all shapes. Creamy ivory areas at the top and bottom become soft muted plum-lavender fish paste; the central golden toasted areas become a mixture of rich burgundy, aubergine and plum brown, with a few muted caramel-gold patches remaining. Keep natural detailed cooked-food appearance. Make it resemble the lower purple chikuwa in the second reference image, but transfer ONLY its palette. Primary image 1 is the texture edit target; image 2 is color reference only. Do not make the purple fluorescent or neon. Do not add darker circular holes, eyes, body segments, scales, ridges, new spots, new lighting, shadows or text. Retain the original texture geometry and dimensions exactly. Output the flat texture filling the entire image, no perspective, no 3D object, no background or labels.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: physically useful grayscale HEIGHT / DISPLACEMENT MAP for a 3D chikuwa fish-cake surface. Input image 1 is the exact flat UV basecolor to match pixel-for-pixel, portrait 1024x1536. Input image 2 is the desired physical food surface, use its upper normal chikuwa only as relief guidance. Produce ONE grayscale height map registered to image 1, preserving the same placement and boundaries of the small blister islands and wrinkled skin. This is a HEIGHT MAP, NOT a grayscale photograph: ignore brown color darkness and ignore all photographic highlights. Mid-gray 128 is the average smooth fish-paste surface; the gently inflated centers of thin toasted-skin blisters are lighter gray 155–195; thin shallow crease lines around and across blisters are darker gray 95–120. Puffing is small, soft, irregular and appetizing, not hard tiles, scales, cobblestones or chunky raised plates. The top and bottom white-fish-paste zones of image 1 should stay mostly medium gray with slight organic surface waviness, subtle small wrinkles and pores, WITHOUT being white just because their albedo is white. Preserve the irregular toasted region's position but no rectangular band boundaries. Central skin has multiple scales of relief: broad very shallow local puffing, small soft blisters, fine delicate wrinkles. No overall slope, no perspective, no object silhouette, no shadows, no directional lighting, no cavity hole, no black or white clipping, no text or border. Left and right edges must tile smoothly at identical heights. Image fills entire frame. Do not introduce any repeated transverse rings, segmented worm shape, regular grid or checker texture. Crucially, the dark toasted patches of the albedo are NOT automatically depressions: derive skin shape, not color brightness.
